name: VertexProbe
description: Reports the clicked feature's label and vertex count. Only meaningful on TrueVector, which stamps the count at make time; on any other vector-ish type it walks the geometry itself.

components.name: Label property
components.description: Feature property to name the feature by. Blank leaves the layer type's declared value standing.

components.name: Vertex-count property
components.description: Property TrueVector stamped the vertex count onto. Blank uses what the layer type declared.
